name: Honor the Dead
label: Quest
description: Honor the Dead: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Five of my best field agents were assigned the Marris case. One returned, only to end up dead in his sleep three days later.
What little information we did manage to get out of him was incoherent gibberish. We made out two words: "Nathanos," and "Blightcaller."

I do not have the available manpower to continue this investigation and Ravenholdt will not assist us. We must get to the bottom of this; if only to provide closure to the families of the deceased. Will you help?

clips.title: Completion
paras: I had faith that Bolvar would send me men and women of honor - the most dedicated soldiers of the Alliance.
